title: ESA Hera Mission Reveals Stadium-Sized Crater From DART
excerpt: The European Space Agency's Hera mission has started capturing images showing the aftermath of NASA's DART impact on an asteroid.
body_html:
The European Space Agency's Hera mission has started capturing images that reveal the consequences of NASA's DART impact.

According to the European Space Agency findings, the DART mission successfully created a stadium-sized crater on the targeted asteroid. The Hera spacecraft is now documenting the site as part of its ongoing investigation into the collision's effects.
